acceptance: Before any widget exists an HTML block is classified with the product's inputs: safe blocks, details, unknown custom and component-like elements render (unknown tags reduced to their content, event handlers stripped, reduced styles granting nothing); a blocked root, a form, an unsafe link, an iframe with extra behaviour or a plain-HTTP one stay source with a stable code (a mismatched pair is malformed); a lone HTTPS iframe is an embed; README align attributes become alignment and invalid ones inherit; every tag of the safe-block and safe-media profiles is admitted; a blank-line-split README header is one flow (also from an inner fragment), mounted whole as one widget with its five images and four links in editable and read-only views; a flow across Markdown renders that Markdown, one that never closes stays source, adjacent complete blocks stay independent; an unavailable local or plain-HTTP image keeps its alt text.

reason: TS projects one HTML classification onto five surfaces (live editable, live read-only, isolated fragment, export and index), each only reducing capability, and checks that none upgrades an unsupported result. The native editor has only the two live surfaces, which share one plan set (covered by the policy and README header tests); there is no fragment, export or index projection.
